For U.S Users



Step 1: Enter Your Bank Info (Fully Secure)

Input your U.S. account details safely — we don’t store anything. Your info is used once to pay you instantly.



Step 2: Verify Instantly

We’ll send a $1 test deposit to verify everything is set up correctly.



Step 3: Transfer Crypto

Send the Crypto of your choice to the wallet address we provide.



Cash in Seconds:

Instant Cash to Your Account As soon as your Crypto is confirmed, USD is deposited directly into your bank.



To keep things smooth and under the radar, we recommend staying under $500 per transaction.

For UK Users



Step 1: Enter Your Bank Details

Provide your UK bank account information securely. All data is protected with advanced, military-grade encryption — we do not store or share your information under any circumstances.



Step 2: Verify Instantly

We’ll send a £1 test payment to confirm your bank account is active and ready to receive funds.



Step 3: Send Your Crypto

Transfer your preferred cryptocurrency — including BTC, ETH, USDT, and others — to the unique wallet address we provide..



Step 4: Get Paid Instantly in GBP

Once your Crypto is confirmed on the blockchain, the equivalent amount in GBP is instantly deposited into your verified bank account..



Note: To ensure smooth processing and avoid potential delays or flagging, we recommend keeping individual transactions below £500.
